children: Billionaire Aliko Dangote is seeking a roughly $50 bln valuation in Africa’s biggest IPO. His large Lagos refinery has real cost advantages, but investors must decide whether it deserves a premium to larger US refiners and how long today’s strong margins will last.
Full view will be published shortly.
Follow Yawen Chen on Bluesky and LinkedIn.

Nigerian billionaire Aliko Dangote on September 14 launched Africa's largest share sale yet with the initial public offering of his oil refinery, tapping the general public to raise as much as $2.1 billion for its expansion.
